RagShortTexts: Anchored in the Southern Uplands, the Black Douglas perfected savage border guerrilla.

Variants.Content: Emerging from the Southern Uplands, the Black Douglas under William the Hardy mastered ruthless night raids along the Tweed. Their hard-hitting light cavalry and schiltron spearmen struck terror into northern English border marches.
Uncompromising and fiercely patriotic, the Douglas clan prioritized asymmetric woodland warfare over rigid chivalric pageantry.
